summary: Phase 5.7A Tail Risk Guard testing complete. 39 pytest tests PASSED (22 unit tests + 4 endpoint contract + 7 regression + 2 integration + 4 fixture tests). Frontend /admin/futures/tail-risk page loads correctly with all required panels. Cross-layer integration verified in strategy-governance, cluster-risk, and capital-governance pages.

critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/futures/tail-risk returns correct contract: tail_risk_score, risk_state, active_alerts, liquidation_cascade, extreme_volatility, exchange_health, tail_risk_history

GET /api/admin/futures/global-risk returns correct contract: global_risk_score, risk_state, active_alerts, components (strategy_risk_component, cluster_risk_component, capital_risk_component, tail_risk_component), weights
Global risk weights correctly configured: strategy=0.25, cluster=0.25, capital=0.20, tail_risk=0.30 (sum=1.0)
Global score thresholds working: >60 DOWNSHIFT, >80 THROTTLE, >90 PAUSE with correct events (GLOBAL_RISK_ALERT, GLOBAL_RISK_THROTTLE, TRADE_ENGINE_PAUSED)
Liquidation cascade guard emits LIQUIDATION_CASCADE_ALERT when >=2 triggers active (RAPID_PRICE_DROP, LIQUIDATION_VOLUME_SPIKE, FUNDING_RATE_ANOMALY)
Extreme volatility guard emits EXTREME_VOLATILITY_ALERT when >=2 triggers active (ATR_EXPLOSION, PRICE_DELTA_ANOMALY, VOLATILITY_PERCENTILE_SPIKE)
Exchange outage guard emits EXCHANGE_HEALTH_ALERT with trade_pause=true when >=2 triggers (API_LATENCY_SPIKE, ACK_DELAY_SPIKE, ORDER_REJECT_ANOMALY, HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT)
Tail risk order guard correctly REJECTS on PAUSE state (size_multiplier=0, event=TAIL_RISK_TRADE_REJECTED), REDUCES on THROTTLE (0.45) and DOWNSHIFT (0.7)
Tail risk audit correctly builds event list: TAIL_RISK_ALERT, detector events, global events, order events
Trading engine integration: apply_tail_risk_order_guard_to_decisions properly integrated at line 475 in futures_strategy_service.py
Frontend /admin/futures/tail-risk renders: score gauge, global risk score, liquidation monitor, volatility chart, exchange health, cross-layer integration panel
Cross-layer integration: strategy-governance, cluster-risk, capital-governance all show GLOBALRISK value

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5.7A Tail Risk Guard fully verified. Key features: (1) Tail Risk Detector computes tail_risk_score from volatility_pct, liquidation_pressure_input, liquidity_depth_score, spread_bps with fallback_mode applying min 62 score, (2) Liquidation Cascade Guard emits LIQUIDATION_CASCADE_ALERT when >=2 of RAPID_PRICE_DROP/LIQUIDATION_VOLUME_SPIKE/FUNDING_RATE_ANOMALY triggers active with position_size_multiplier=0.45, (3) Extreme Volatility Guard emits EXTREME_VOLATILITY_ALERT when >=2 of ATR_EXPLOSION/PRICE_DELTA_ANOMALY/VOLATILITY_PERCENTILE_SPIKE triggers with trade_frequency_multiplier=0.5 and position_size_multiplier=0.6, (4) Exchange Outage Guard emits EXCHANGE_HEALTH_ALERT with trade_pause=true when >=2 of API_LATENCY_SPIKE/ACK_DELAY_SPIKE/ORDER_REJECT_ANOMALY/HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT triggers, (5) Global Risk Score Engine uses weights strategy=0.25, cluster=0.25, capital=0.20, tail_risk=0.30 with thresholds >60=DOWNSHIFT, >80=THROTTLE, >90=PAUSE, (6) Tail Risk Order Guard REJECTS on PAUSE (size_multiplier=0, TAIL_RISK_TRADE_REJECTED event), REDUCE_SIZE on THROTTLE (0.45) or DOWNSHIFT (0.7), (7) Tail Risk Audit builds TAIL_RISK_ALERT + detector + global + order events. Frontend page at /admin/futures/tail-risk with data-testid=nav-admin-futures-tail-risk-link. UI shows: score cards (tail/global score + state), score gauge panel, liquidation pressure monitor, volatility spike chart, exchange health status, cross-layer integration panel.
